descriptions.d31j_build_image_grid_80183ed0: Creates the image; loads the texture named by the path through the texture loader, reporting failure through discarded string copies; applies the texture options unless bit 256 is set; creates the material, geometry and modifier; divides the texture into cells, fills the UV and step arrays row by row; stores the geometry, registers it with two services, creates the instance, applies option flags through virtual setters, computes bounds from a default sphere and clears dirty markers.
